purpose: Bounded development comparison of the historical and corrected transverse G08 TET10 meshes.
scope: Compare the combined effect of mesh connectivity and discretization. The 276-versus-300 free-DOF difference prevents attributing an observed response difference to connectivity alone.

before.source_inventory_entry: scopes.g08-tet10-before in source-inventory.json; its digest is recorded by the official preflight

after.source_inventory_entry: scopes.g08-tet10-after in source-inventory.json; its digest is recorded by the official preflight

model.supports: All UX, UY and UZ translations fixed at x=0.
model.loading: Nodal UX compression at x=4; each of 25 loaded nodes receives -0.04 force units; total resultant is -1 force unit.

analysis.spectral_method: The solver first tries generalized eigsh when -Kg is positive definite. Otherwise it brackets loss of positive definiteness of K0 + lambda*Kg using sparse smallest-algebraic eigenvalues and may refine with generalized eigs shift-invert. Archive the actual backend, formulation, bracket, fallbacks and tolerances.
analysis.termination: One attempt per exact scope. Preserve timeout, resource stop, exception, non-convergence, solver non-pass and incomplete archive without retry. Run before first, archive and inspect, then run after.

resource_envelope.resource_limit_note: RSS, process count and storage are sampled workflow monitors rather than hard OS quotas; captured stdout/stderr limits are enforced by the runner.

compare: normalized mode on shared coordinates with consistent sign
evaluation.screening_interpretation: Screens classify whether each computed result lies within the predeclared numerical band; they do not establish physical validity or attribute A/B differences to connectivity alone.
evaluation.first_mode_evidence_required: A low eigenpair residual is insufficient. A first-mode claim separately requires positivity evidence for K0, the actually resolved reduced pencil, degree-of-freedom correspondence, and lower/upper inertia counts with error bounds that certify a simple crossing or a near-mode subspace.

expected_archives: run.json with runner state and resource observations
